welcome.title: Welcome to Tiny UI Fix 2
welcome.subtitle: The Sims 3's interface at the right size for your screen, sharp and without breaking your mods.
welcome.changeLater: You can change it in the next step, with a preview.
welcome.step1: Choose the game and the interface size.
welcome.step2: Fixes for the game and for your mods; the recommended ones are already on.
welcome.step3: Cursor size and a warning when mods change. Then just generate.
welcome.footnote: Nothing changes in the game until you generate the package. To undo it, use Maintenance › Uninstall.
size.title: Interface size
size.subtitle: Make the game's menus, buttons and text bigger without losing sharpness. 1× is the original size.
size.previewCaption: Your screen, {0}×{1} ({2}, {3}), with the game's HUD at {4} in its real proportion.
size.fromMonitor: your monitor's resolution, as the game hasn't saved its own yet
size.ultrawide: On an ultrawide screen the game shows more at the sides; the HUD stays in the corner, as here.
size.textSame: Text the same size as the interface
size.textSameHelp: Turn off to pick a different text size. Text much bigger than the interface can overlap other elements.
compat.subtitle: Fixes that adapt the game and your mods to the bigger interface. The recommended ones were detected in your mods.
compat.orderHelp: Drag to change the order the active fixes are applied in. The Nucleus always comes first. If unsure, leave it as it is.
reason.vanilla: the game's original DLLs are active.
patch.Nucleus.name: Nucleus
patch.Nucleus.details: The base of Tiny UI Fix. The package doesn't work without it.
patch.VanillaCoreCompatibilityPatch.name: Game compatibility
patch.VanillaCoreCompatibilityPatch.deta: Adapts the game's own code to the bigger interface: windows, lists and menus that the game positions in code.
patch.CompatibilityPatchesForNRaasMods.d: Makes NRaas menus (MasterController, Overwatch, ErrorTrap and others) fully work with the bigger interface.
patch.CompatibilityPatchForSmoothPatch.d: Fixes scrolling through clothes in Create a Sim when LazyDuchess's Smooth Patch is active.
patch.SliderEnhancements.name: Better sliders
patch.SliderEnhancements.details:
• Right-click a slider to type its value.
• With the mouse over a slider: A and D change it by 1, S and W by 8, F and R by 32. With Shift: 64, 128 and 256.
• In Create a Sim the keys work on the last slider used, even while turning the camera.
• Ten memories: Alt + a number key saves the value, the number key alone loads it. Shift + 0 resets the memories.
• In Create a Sim, values can go past their usual limits.
cursor.sizeHelp: Above 2× the graphics card may stop drawing the cursor itself, which costs a few FPS.
cursor.methodHelp: Only matters when the cursor is bigger than 1×.
cursor.sharpHelp: Scales up without smoothing first, then fits the final size.
cursor.warnHelp: Shows a warning in the main menu if you add or remove mods after generating the package, as a reminder to generate it again.
